## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes and `pnpm build` succeeds
- [ ] Tests added or updated (or explained why not)
- [ ] Tested manually in a Chromium-based browser (light and dark theme)
- [ ] No new network requests, CDN assets, or permissions (or justified and documented)
- [ ] Stored-data changes include a migration (storage keys, export formats)
